reviews.x: This is actually a good alternative and smells just like the actual perfume. I am impressed and will be a returning customer!

This is an excellent way to try out those expensive perfumes and to see if they work for you! I’ve always wondered if Baccarat Rouge, Santal, Love don’t be shy and a bunch of Tom Ford perfumes is something I’d want to invest in as for now my top price tier is Chanel and Mugler. But I got Baccarat Rouge from this seller and will buy the rest from my list to try and see how they work for me. So far it’s super strong and lasting for a good few hours strong.

I purchased this dupe spray of Baccarat Rouge after reading the amazing reviews. I received it yesterday in time for the holidays.  I would give it -5 stars if I could. It smells terrible and cannot be returned (even on prime). Worse purchase that I ever made an Amazon.  Save your pennies and buy the real stuff. This bottle went directly into the trash where it belongs.

It's light, and woodsy and smells oh so yummy on my husband, and it doesn't make him break out or itch!!  It actually lasts all day on him, so I'm definitely getting more!  You made this wifey VERY happy!!!

My wife loves Si. We did two blinded smell tests and she passed both. The real Si is more pungent, more nuanced, has more disparate aromas. The CA is has a bit more of an alcohol smell. They are, however, similar.
Thank you very much for the gift. I never imagined that I would like it so much. I will no longer spend so much money having you, thank you and I am already preparing my new order

I am very happy with my perfume order, it smells just like Baccarat Rouge 540 and I just saved $300-$400 for not purchasing the original :).  I recommend.

The fragrance in her bottle is clear the fragrance in my bottle is yellow. Please make sure you're using same ingredients for each bottle you make.

reviews.t: Haven’t had anything from this company I didn’t like
reviews.x: Can’t speak for all fragrance impressions but over the past 7 or so I’ve used they’ve all been pretty spot on. The dior sauvage impression has a slightly sweeter and fresher scent than the real thing but it’s only noticeable if you’re smelling them side by side.  Longevity is up to par with most edp’s on the market.

reviews.t: Does not smell like the original
reviews.x: Does not resemble the original scent at all.  Overpowering and offensive and even after a shower, scent is still there. So disappointed.  I did not realize this was not returnable when I made the purchase or would not have ordered.

reviews.t: I have all the original twice this is everything!
reviews.x: I’ve ordered the several hundred dollar original version twice since then I bought this three times and every day a random person will stop me and say how amazing I smell dollar for dollar you cannot lose with this just buy it

reviews.t: An excellent value for money EDP
reviews.x: This is an excellent value for money product. They also send a free sample along! The scent, though, is not long lasting - but then considering the amount we pay for it, I guess that's what we should expect.

reviews.t: I haven’t smelled anything he real thing
reviews.x: This stuff stinks. It stays on your hands and clothes even after you wash. I don’t know what the real perfume smells like but this is not a great smell. It is overwhelming by any measure.
I realize this is a knockoff but the scent lasts less than a minute. Don't waste your money. There's other dupes that last longer.
Love the product. It smells so good. Got it for my mom she loves it I love it!!

reviews.t: One of the best Amazon purchases I’ve made!
reviews.x: Not only does the product smell *EXACTLY* like Roses Musk on my skin…same powerful projection, longevity, and base/heart/top notes…the seller included a full size, hand sanitizing cologne in a complementary scent…for free. I’m overjoyed by things like this. Will be a repeat customer. They made a bad day so much better with their excellence and thoughtfulness.

reviews.t: The best fragrance version I’ve had!
reviews.x: I ordered a couple of scents I haven’t been able to find, Fierce for men and women, also Coco mademoiselle and there was a slight mix up in what was sent. The customer service was the best ever and they even scent me a couple of different scents I asked about, at no charge. Their version was better than the originals! You won’t be disappointed.

This smells nothing like the fragrance it is supposed to be similar to. It smelled so sickly sweet and chemical-y I threw it away. The packaging looked like something you would print up at home. Really bad.
I've had this scent in the roll on and this spray version and I love both! Can't beat the price they offer for such long lasting smells and my girlfriend loves it too! Win win!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the scent closely matches the original designer perfume, often at a much lower price.
Several reviewers complain the fragrance is weak, short-lasting, or smells like nothing or rubbing alcohol.
Some reviewers report the scent does not resemble the original and find it unpleasant or overpowering.
A few reviewers mention cheap plastic bottles or broken sprayers.
Some reviewers are disappointed that the product cannot be returned.
